segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers top-of-hour sign-on; Case discusses streaming logistics, medical advice jokes, and Kendall's Jack in the Box tattoo reveal.

segments.title: VP Debate Recap: Vance vs. Walz
segments.notes: Case and Tyler watch Boston Globe highlight reel of vice presidential debate; commentary on Vance's eyeliner, Walz's nervous affect, and cordial tone.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Trailers Roundup
segments.notes: Trent presents trailers for Indiana Jones and the Great Circle (game), Better Man (Robbie Williams as CGI monkey), Winnie's Hole, and The Franchise series.

segments.title: How To: Lie to Friends, Use a Urinal, Sniff Glue
segments.notes: Jeb airs three vintage how-to videos: Daily Grace on lying to friends, Adventure Bros on urinal etiquette, and a 2005 prank on getting high from glue.

segments.title: Jo Rogen Experience: Gardening, Comedy Specials, Glue Man Jamie
segments.notes: Case and Tyler parody Joe Rogan discussing gardening faces, Rogan's comedy special reception, and producer Jamie's transformation into glue-trapped 'glue man'.

segments.title: Outro & Raid to Sir Lar
segments.notes: Case plugs Patreon cream.team stream, nominates mayors for tomorrow, and raids Sir Lar in memory of Casem.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers station sign-on and cold open; debates Pepito merch and plushie concepts with Case.

characters.name: Tyler
characters.notes: debate analyst. Co-hosts VP debate watch and movie segment; mistaken for JD Vance by chat; offers gardening face impression.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Referenced for Jack in the Box tattoo and wearing handmade Case Blackwell merch; not physically on camera.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: field correspondent. Hosts movie trailer segment 'Trent at the Movies'; presents four trailers under time pressure.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: recurring. Hosts How To with Jeb from workshop; airs three vintage how-to videos; claims progress freeing father from wood.

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: recurring. Spirit trapped in wooden board; argues with Jeb about escape prospects; votes in chat poll via exclamation points.

characters.name: Joe Rogan
characters.notes: call-in guest. Parody appearance in Jo Rogen Experience; discusses gardening, comedy special backlash, and glue-man producer Jamie.

lore_notes.fact: Got a tattoo at a Jack in the Box event; wears handmade Case Blackwell merch. [10:03]
Considers making 'lubechef' shirts; questions Comcast IP implications. [12:12]
Claims to have figured out how to free his father from the wood, though father insists it's impossible. [52:33]
Transformed into 'glue man' after months of gluing fly corpses to newspaper; stuck to chair, mostly glue, speaks only 'I glue man, touch me become me'. [01:08:46]

episode_summary: Case Blackwell and Tyler recap the Vance-Walz vice presidential debate with Boston Globe highlights, then Trent presents a rapid-fire movie trailer block including an Indiana Jones game, Robbie Williams monkey biopic, and Winnie the Pooh horror game. Jeb Nogget returns with vintage how-to videos on lying, urinals, and a glue-sniffing prank, while his wood-trapped father votes via chat poll. The broadcast closes with a Jo Rogen Experience parody where Joe Rogan discusses gardening, his panned comedy special, and producer Jamie's grotesque glue-man transformation.
